the addition of nano silica to cement paste improves mechanical strength, durability and workability of the concrete.
the addition of silica nanoparticles into cement matrix improves mechanical properties, durability aspects and also the microstructure of concrete.
the nano silica has been proved to be an effective additive in cementitious materials.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of nano materials on the mechanical and durability properties of concrete.
the development of nano silica based materials and its application to concrete technology for development of sustainable materials.
the synthesis of nano-silica particles, their characterization and their use in cementitious materials.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, nano silica is a promising pozzolan for concrete.
the addition of nano silica into cement paste and concrete has shown a significant improvement in strength and durability characteristics.
the addition of nano silica in various forms and proportions in concrete would be an effective and viable solution to improve the durability aspects and to develop sustainable construction materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nano silica particles can be effectively used to enhance the mechanical properties and durability of concrete.
nano silica is a very good material for concrete.

, the nano silica particles are very effective for improving the strength, durability, and microstructure of concrete and the use of nano silica in cementitious composites is a promising area of research and development for sustainable construction.

nano silica has a significant influence on the properties of concrete.
nano silica has a potential to improve concrete strength, durability and workability and thus, it is a sustainable material for the construction industry.
